scripts.text:
[ Ringing Voice ]
Courageous one,
do you wish to return
to your stronghold?
scripts.translation:
[回响的声音]
勇士啊，你要返回自己的要塞吗？

scripts.text:
[ Arunafeltz Royal Edict ]
The Holy Kingdom of
Arunafeltz decrees that
this stronghold is owned
by the ^FF0000{0}^000000 Guild.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁纳菲兹王国敕令]
神圣的阿鲁纳菲兹王国宣布，此要塞归^FF0000{0}^000000公会所有。

scripts.text:
[ Schwarzwald Royal Edict ]
The Holy Kingdom of
Schwarzwald decrees that
this stronghold is owned
by the ^FF0000{0}^000000 Guild.
scripts.translation:
[修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德王国敕令]
神圣的修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德王国宣布，此要塞归^FF0000{0}^000000公会所有。

scripts.text:
[ Arunafeltz Royal Edict ]
The Holy Kingdom of
Arunafeltz declares that
one has yet to claim lordship
over this stronghold. The one
that breaks the Emperium will
be recognized as its new owner.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁纳菲兹王国敕令]
神圣的阿鲁纳菲兹王国宣布，此要塞尚未有主人。摧毁华丽金属的人将被认可为新的主人。

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[ Arunafeltz Royal Edict ]
^FF0000{0}^000000 is
Guild Master of ^FF0000{1}^000000.
Any that object must claim this
stronghold through strength of
steel and magic during the
appointed Guild Siege times.
scripts.translation:
[阿鲁纳菲兹王国敕令]
^FF0000{0}^000000是^FF0000{1}^000000公会的会长。
任何反对者，都必须在公会战期间以钢铁与魔法的力量夺下这座要塞。
